verdict.rationale: Error-tracking platforms routinely publish API specs, so this axis applies. The pack has no evidence of a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec: probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on glitchtip.com all returned 404. The 'Sentry API compatible' claim and the MCP server are not a machine-readable spec. Note the probes only checked the marketing domain, so a spec served by a self-hosted instance may exist undocumented, hence medium confidence.
